description: Public starter footage for the PoC. scripts/fetch_footage.sh downloads each source file, trims it, and writes data/footage/ATTRIBUTION.md. Camera times are each site's local wall-clock time; for CAVIAR and NVIDIA the date and time are illustrative because the sources carry none.

meva.name: MEVA (Multiview Extended Video with Activities)
meva.attribution: "Multiview Extended Video with Activities" (MEVA) dataset by Kitware Inc. and the Intelligence Advanced Research Projects Activity (IARPA), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Clips were trimmed and re-encoded without audio.

caviar.name: CAVIAR test case scenarios
caviar.licence: Creative Commons BY-SA (version not stated by the source)
caviar.attribution: Data from the EC Funded CAVIAR project/IST 2001 37540, found at http://homepages.inf.ed.ac.uk/rbf/CAVIAR/ . Re-encoded to H.264 without changes to the picture; share-alike applies to these copies.

nvidia.name: NVIDIA PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces (synthetic, MTMC_Tracking_2024)
nvidia.attribution: Physical AI Smart Spaces dataset by NVIDIA, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Synthetic people generated with Omniverse. Clips were trimmed and re-encoded without audio.

pexels.name: Pexels
pexels.attribution: Stock video from Pexels; credit is not required by the Pexels License but is given here. Identifiable people may not appear in a bad light, so these clips are only ever used for neutral searches and never as a suspect or in a demo story.

clips.notes: Same waiting room on another day; bags put down at about 0:19 and 0:40 into this trim.

left_out.reason: No part of the data may go to third parties, so it cannot appear in a client demo.
The Envato use policy bans using assets to train or improve AI.
Non-commercial licences are excluded for a commercial PoC.
